name: Alterac Valley
summary: In Alterac Valley, the Frostwolves and Stormpike dwarves fight for control of the snow. The dwarves seek riches and relics they believe link them to their ancestors, while the Frostwolves fight to drive them out. Each side presses through towers and graveyards toward the other's general: Vanndar Stormpike in Dun Baldar or Drek'Thar in Frostwolf Keep.

sections.title: Home of the Frostwolves
sections.body:
Gul'dan exiled Durotan's Frostwolf clan for defying him, and the orcs found refuge in this cold valley. They made it their home. Long afterward, young Thrall found his father's people here and learned shaman ways from Drek'Thar, the elder.

Thrall now leads the Horde in Kalimdor. Many Frostwolves remain in the valley under Drek'Thar's guidance, guarding their homeland fiercely.

sections.title: The Stormpike Expedition
sections.body:
Led by Vanndar Stormpike, the Stormpike Guard is an expedition of Ironforge dwarves based at the northern fortress of Dun Baldar. They came for the valley's mines and for relics they believe link them to their ancestors.

They have dug in with bunkers and towers, holding fast with stubborn pride. The Frostwolves call them invaders; the dwarves claim the valley's secrets by right of discovery.

sections.title: War in the Snow
sections.body:
The battle for Alterac Valley pits one army against another. Fighters storm towers and bunkers, seize graveyards, and claim the valley's mines for their side.

Each side must break through to the enemy general and bring them down. The Horde faces Vanndar Stormpike in Dun Baldar; the Alliance faces Drek'Thar in Frostwolf Keep.

faq.answer: Alterac Valley lies hidden in the Alterac Mountains, and the Frostwolf orcs call it home. The Frostwolf clan and the Stormpike dwarves fight a full-scale war there, each seeking to defeat the other's general.

faq.q: Why do the Frostwolves fight in Alterac Valley?
aliases: why does the horde fight in alterac valley
faq.answer: The valley is the Frostwolves' home, where Durotan's clan settled in exile and where Thrall found his people. They will not let the Stormpike dwarves dig there, and the Horde fights beside them to drive the expedition out.

faq.q: Why are the Stormpike dwarves in Alterac Valley?
faq.answer: The Stormpike expedition came from Ironforge to mine the valley's riches and seek relics they believe link them to their ancestors. Led by Vanndar Stormpike from Dun Baldar, they hold to their claim, with the Alliance fighting beside them.

Drek'Thar is the elder shaman of the Frostwolf clan, and he taught young Thrall the ways of the shaman. He commands the Frostwolves from Frostwolf Keep, and the Alliance must defeat him to win the battle.
Vanndar Stormpike is a dwarf and commander of the Stormpike Guard. He leads the expedition from Dun Baldar, and the Horde must defeat him to win the battle.

faq.q: How is the battle in Alterac Valley won?
faq.answer: Each army fights through the other's towers, bunkers, and graveyards toward its stronghold. The battle ends when one side defeats the enemy's general: Vanndar Stormpike in Dun Baldar or Drek'Thar in Frostwolf Keep.

angles.text: The snows of Alterac Valley are the Warchief's own homeland. Every Horde fighter there defends the place where Thrall found his people.
Alliance soldiers march with the Stormpike Guard to hold the valley's mines and secrets against the Frostwolf horde.
The Frostwolves are Durotan's clan and Thrall's blood. For an orc, defending their valley means defending the heart of the new Horde.
Stormpike dwarves see the valley's relics as a link to their ancestors. No clan of orcs will drive them from their diggings.
